The SCI (p.4, three-month and six-month columns side by side) mixes signs: insurance service expenses are bracketed, but the insurance finance expense, other finance costs and other operating expenses are printed positive (turned negative). The tax line, labelled 'expense (income)', prints the six-month figure (234,618.14) in brackets and the three-month figure 415,829.62 without; the arithmetic shows the first is an expense and the second a credit (profit before tax + line = net result), so both are kept as printed. No reinsurance line. Note 8 six months (p.63; columns group / ordinary / total) prints expenses positive (turned negative). No PAA business; other revenue = รายการอื่น. CSM roll-forward 9.2 total p.75-76; new business 9.3 p.86 prints only the total of future cash outflows (owner decision: not disclosed, no estimate; the total is the memo figure nb_pv_outflows and reconciles). The half-year is a net loss with large onerous losses (5,882,412.08). RA release uses note 8 (2,540,642.03), not the AOC RA (2,168,589.45). Other expense = other finance costs + other operating expenses. The three-month profit or loss is the SCI three-month column (p.4).
